notes: P0 draft. No FOP importer exists yet and FUT/FOP ledgers are frozen, so nothing here is consumed at runtime. P4 wires the importer and the store to this file.
A key is format/section/asset/event. The asset may carry a qualifier (FOP.cash_settled) for rows whose format is ordinary but whose product is outside the first release.
Section slugs are placeholders until P4 maps them to the real Activity Statement and Flex section names.

statusDefinitions.real_verified: Accepted from a de-identified real statement: needs at least one evidence entry of kind deidentified_real with verifiedOn and mappingVersion. Only these keys may be written.
statusDefinitions.synthetic_only: No real-statement acceptance. Preview only. A synthetic evidence entry, when present, records that the synthetic fixture passed; it never makes the key writable.
statusDefinitions.out_of_scope: Recognised and deliberately not imported (daily settlement and cash sections, plan §6.3). Neither blocks nor writes.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: A recognised economic row the first release does not support (plan §1.2). Blocks its batch and cannot be claimed by a manual event.
